points.description: States the core idea of merge sort: the array is divided into halves, each half is sorted, and the sorted halves are merged together (divide, sort/recursively sort, merge).
points.partial_credit: Award 2-3 marks if only part is given, e.g. only splitting into halves, or only merging sorted pieces, without the full divide-sort-merge idea.

rubric.notes: Full marks for any wording that says the array is split into two parts, each part is sorted (recursion is fine but not required), and the sorted parts are merged. Give part marks for an answer with only half of this, such as just splitting or just merging. Give no marks for descriptions of other sorts or unrelated remarks; extra correct detail like O(n log n) is fine.
